    Early Childhood Development (ECD)

    Dedicated to the training of early childhood educators through the Infant Course of the Diploma in Education and the ECD Short Course. Covers developmental psychology, ECD methodology and community-based programming.

    View ECD Short Course View All Departments
    Department of Early Childhood Development

    Department Overview

    The ECD Department is at the forefront of early childhood teacher education in Zimbabwe. With 660+ ECD Short Course graduates and the Infant Course of the Diploma in Education, the department produces competent, caring educators for the foundational years of learning.

    👤

    [To be updated]

    Head of Department — ECD

    ECD Methodology

    Pedagogical approaches for early childhood education including play-based learning, inquiry methods, and developmentally appropriate practice.

    Developmental Psychology

    Child development theories, cognitive, social-emotional, and physical development milestones from birth to age 8.

    ECD Short Course

    6-month certificate programme for ECD centre facilitators. 660+ graduates. Community-based, practical, and accessible.

    Infant Teaching Practice

    Supervised practical experience in ECD centres and infant classrooms. Mentored by qualified ECD practitioners.

    Creative Arts in ECD

    Music, movement, visual arts, and drama for young children. Integrating creativity across the ECD curriculum.

    Nurturing Zimbabwe's Youngest Learners

    Quality early childhood education is the foundation for lifelong learning. Our graduates make a difference in communities across Zimbabwe.
